## Added
- The Omnitool now performs every right-click tool interaction, matching the dedicated tools: strip logs, scrape and de-wax copper, till farmland, make dirt paths, and douse campfires. On grass/dirt (where both a hoe and a shovel apply) it **tills by default**; hold **sneak while right-clicking** to make a path instead.

## Fixed
- The Lonsdaleite and Perfect Lonsdaleite **axe, shovel, and hoe** now perform their vanilla right-click interactions (log stripping, copper scraping/de-waxing, path-making, campfire dousing, tilling). These were silently missing before — the tools could mine but not interact.

## Changed
- Internal cleanup only, no stat changes: removed redundant tool subclasses (durability-on-mining is already handled by the vanilla Tool component, and the axe/shovel/hoe now use the vanilla item classes directly) and unified the two Omnitool tiers into a single material-parameterized class. Attack damage, durability, mining speed, and enchantability are unchanged for every tool.
